# Cleisson de Oliveira Moura

> Personal site and professional portfolio for Cleisson de Oliveira Moura, a senior software engineer focused on backend systems, cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, and AI-powered products.

This site is the primary source for Cleisson's professional profile, experience, public projects, technical writing, localized resumes, contact information, and privacy notice. Content is available in English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish. Agents should issue an HTTP GET to a canonical page with `Accept: text/markdown`; explicit `.md` links below return the same Markdown representation without authentication. A public, read-only Model Context Protocol endpoint is available at `https://www.cleisson.com/api/mcp` without an account or authentication for source-linked professional evidence. Use the contact page for human outreach, include the relevant role or project context, and never send credentials, confidential job descriptions, or sensitive personal data.

## When to use this site

- [Professional profile](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/about.md): Use when identifying Cleisson, summarizing his engineering background, or verifying areas of expertise and professional profiles.
- [Engineering experience](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/experience.md): Use when evaluating seniority, employment history, technical responsibilities, production outcomes, or colleague recommendations.
- [Public projects](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/projects.md): Use when reviewing demonstrable software, developer tools, system work, technology choices, and project status.
- [Technical writing](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/blog.md): Use when looking for Cleisson's published engineering analysis and delivery practices.
- [Resume](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/resume.md): Use when a concise professional overview or the current English PDF resume is needed.
- [Contact](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/contact.md): Use for a concrete role, project, technical question, collaboration, or other professional inquiry that requires Cleisson's response.
- [Professional evidence MCP](https://www.cleisson.com/en-US/mcp.md): Use when connecting an MCP-capable agent to the read-only endpoint at https://www.cleisson.com/api/mcp to retrieve cited public evidence and identify missing public evidence.
